prompt: A radiant, golden Buddha sits in perfect lotus posture on a large, glowing lotus flower that reflects on a still, mirror-like water surface. The Buddha’s entire form seems to be illuminated from within, radiating warm, golden light. Around His head, an intense aura forms a luminous halo, emphasizing His divine presence. Delicate streams of energy swirl around Him, adding a sense of sacred mysticism to the scene. The lotus petals below are richly detailed, each one shimmering in shades of gold and orange. In the Buddha’s chest area, a soft glow appears, symbolizing spiritual power or enlightenment. The background is pitch black, providing a stark contrast that highlights every bright detail, making the entire figure appear even more transcendent. The overall mood conveys profound serenity, spiritual depth, and an uplifting sense of enlightenment. --ar 9:16 --v 6.1
